message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: In Jan 2013, defendant Wang (王某甲) contracted a construction group for exterior wall insulation. To settle payment, he paid 37,000 RMB as "invoice fee" to have someone help him falsify a value-added tax ordinary invoice (not special) issued by a certain hardware company, Dalian city, amount total 1,257,814.95 RMB. The invoice was examined and found to have differences from the company's printed invoices. In March 2015, after police call, he voluntarily turned himself and confessed. Evidence includes etc.

Thus the crime is "虚开增值税普通发票" (falsely issuing VAT ordinary invoice). In examples, they label as "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票" for special invoice. For ordinary invoice, they may just say "虚开增值税普通发票". In earlier examples, they used "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". For ordinary invoice, they haven't given an example. But we can infer the label: "虚开增值税普通发票". Also maybe "经济犯" (economic crime) but not needed. The pattern: they list multiple crimes separated by semicolons. Here only one crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]虚开增值税普通发票<eoa>
